quest.title: "Vibro-Crystals. It's Always Vibro-Crystals..."
quest.description: A pair of engineers from Fontaine is currently performing some rather esoteric research in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: Quick, Anatole, dig out whatever you've got left for travel expenses...

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: #Alright, alright. But I'm only parting with the bit we owe {NICKNAME} and Paimon for helping with our experiments. No more...

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: As for the rest, we'll see how your product design work comes along, Patrice.

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: Sure, sure. At least the experiments can continue...

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: #In that case, we'll leave the experiment in your hands, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. All the best — the success of the project is riding on you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry, just leave it to us!
Stop it, Patrice! Our current experiments run completely contrary to the Institute's directives...

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: You mean the one on the approval document that says "this project should produce technology that provides greater economic benefits"?

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: They just want to know if it can be sold for Mora, don't worry about that! We just need to continue testing and gathering data, yeah? So, you'll need to give me some more Mora to buy Vibro-Crystals...

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: We don't have that much funding left. Where are you going to get the Mora to hire testers once you've blown it all? Or are you going to do it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: Well, you must remember, dear Anatole, that "research supervisors of outdoor experiments must, if necessity dictates, assist the researcher in performing testing..."

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: I'll leave the next experiment to you, then. Also, I recall that you have a considerable quantity of travel funds, yes? You could always eat fewer meals and...

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: Oh, and now you're putting it upon your colleagues to save Mora on your behalf? Ah, Patrice, how hard your heart is! That Mora is for Bamboo Shoot Soup — not a wicked villain such as yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! You can always work less, but you should never eat less!

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: Precisely so!

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: Ah, I knew it! To speak such piercing insights, you must be the famous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, Paimon's the renowned Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: #Then this must be the renowned {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Anyway, it is just as Paimon says. How could I ever skimp on food?

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: What should I do, then? If I don't have the funding to conduct my experiments, forget the prospect of "greater economic benefits" — the only prospects awaiting me will be "tragedy."

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: *sigh*...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, and by the way, what were you two talking about with all those "prospects"? Are you prospecting?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Economic benefits... Are you two researching how to prospect for Mora? Whoa, i—is there any chance you'll find a way to make Mora just spurt out of the ground like a fountain?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh, I'm in. I'd like a cut.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: No, no, not that kind of prospect at all. That said, I do believe that my research project's "prospects" will turn out to be just as valuable...

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: We need to settle the funding issue first. Also, we need to design an invention that will sell well.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: *cough* Great inventions are often mere byproducts of great research... Marvelous, inventive ideas leap forth like stingrays from your mind as you conduct said research...

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: They'd better.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, hold on a sec. Paimon's getting curious now. Just what sort of research are you doing?

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: We're working on ores known as Vibro-Crystals. We discovered them in Liyue previously while studying the different properties of ore in the region.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: They can be divided into two types: Transmitter and Receiver Crystals.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: When the Transmitter Crystal is stimulated in a certain way, it will release a specific energy that resonates with the Receiver Crystal half, generating unique effects.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Which is an interesting phenomenon, albeit one that... Let's just say that the Fontainian Research Institute isn't nearly as interested in ores as it used to be.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Mr. Raimondo's also been clear that it lacks "economic benefits" — ergo, it won't bring the money in.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: Such shallowness!

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: *sigh* In any case, Patrice was stymied while applying for funding. He didn't manage to secure any Mora, only an honorary title.

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: I thought that I could at least use the title to guarantee an interim loan from the Northland Bank...

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: But the moment the clerks heard that I was an Institute engineer, their smiles melted like snow in spring.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: And no wonder, considering how hard our lot have abused that trick.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: So it is as you see — we're out of funding, and we can't even hire adventurers to help perform our experiments... nor do we have even the foggiest ideas about possible inventions.

response.speaker: Anatole
response.text: Not that this comes as any surprise. I must admit that it's tough, living in a foreign land with little funding while performing complex experiments, maintaining the experimental site, and also trying to design an invention.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, how about we help out, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oho, Paimon's going to become a great inventor, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know the first thing about inventing, but we could do the "performing experiments" part, right?

response.speaker: Patrice
response.text: C—Could you really?

choices.text: I'd imagine that I'm already a bit more than just "renowned."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, why'd you get competitive all of a sudden!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'll have you know that I'm an Honorary Senior Researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: R—Really? Absolutely astonishing, I didn't think that we'd be hearing an Institute honorary title all the way out here...

dialogues.speaker: Patrice
dialogues.text: Well! I'd say that those with the heart to help out deserve all the titles they could ever want, wouldn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, here's an experienced adventurer should you need one.

dialogues.speaker: Anatole
dialogues.text: #In that case, we'll leave the experiment in your hands, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. All the best — the success of the project is riding on you!
